# Recursive Language Model (RLM)

Recursive local-first CLI for prompt decomposition and multi-agent orchestration. It runs against local/remote model hosts via adapters, enforces call/tool budgets, and supports workflow execution with optional QA and validation commands.

## What It Does

- Executes single-agent recursive prompting with decomposition and synthesis.
- Routes model selection by reasoning purpose (`depth`, `classify`, `decompose`, `answer`, `summarize`, `synthesize`).
- Runs multi-agent workflows with RAM-aware dispatch and optional QA validation loops.
- Supports extension-hosted tools and MCP/skill interoperability.

## Repository Map

- `src/index.ts`: CLI entrypoint and runtime wiring.
- `src/application/`: orchestration, config loading, workflow runner, memory manager, model routing.
- `src/domain/`: recursive engine and core shared types.
- `src/cli/`: arg parsing, renderers, runtime logging, shutdown handling.
- `src/ports/`: interfaces for model/tool/tracing/runtime boundaries.
- `src/adapters/`: concrete LM and tooling adapters.
- `ui/`: ReactFlow browser UI for typed node workflow authoring.
- `tests/`: integration-style and behavior tests.

## Prerequisites

- Node.js (project uses modern ESM TypeScript and `tsx` in dev scripts).
- Dependencies installed via `npm install`.
- A configured model host (default expected host is Ollama unless `hosts`/runtime host selection is configured).

## Install

```bash
npm install
npm run build
```

## Usage

```bash
# help
npx rlm help

# single-agent run (auto agent selection)
npx rlm "Summarize this repository architecture"

# fixed agent
npx rlm ask "List runtime risks" --agent qa --json

# workflow run
npx rlm "Plan a small feature" --workflow default --verbose
```

## Core CLI Flags

- `--agent <id>`: force specific configured agent.
- `--workflow <id>`: execute workflow configuration.
- `--config <path>`: use alternate `rlm.config.yaml`.
- `--model <name>`: override default model.
- `--max-depth`, `--branches`, `--max-model-calls`, `--max-tool-rounds`: runtime budget controls.
- `--plan-only`, `--require-approval`, `--approval-mode`, `--approve`: approval-gated execution controls.
- `--json`, `--json-stream`, `--compact`, `--trace`, `--verbose`: output and observability options.

## Configuration

Primary config file: `rlm.config.yaml`.

Main sections:

- `models`: default model and named tiers.
- `memory`: RAM constraints and scheduling behavior.
- `runtime`: recursion/tool/model-call limits.
- `agents`: per-agent tools and per-purpose model tier/selection.
- `workflows`: ordered agent pipelines, optional dispatch tiers, QA validation config.

See [CONFIGURATION](docs/CONFIGURATION.md), [ARCHITECTURE](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md), and [UI](docs/UI.md).
